name: devops-control-center
description: Production-grade internal DevOps platform for ~500 users

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.install:backend: cd backend/services/api-gateway && npm install && cd ../auth-service && npm install && cd ../azure-devops-service && npm install && cd ../sonarqube-service && npm install && cd ../artifactory-service && npm install && cd ../servicenow-service && npm install && cd ../ai-chatbot-service && npm install && cd ../approval-service && npm install
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.db:reset: docker-compose down -v && docker-compose up -d postgres redis && sleep 5 && npm run migrate && npm run seed
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:backend

author: DevOps Platform Team
